focus.note: Linking words join ideas. Ask yourself: is the second idea a contrast, a reason, a result or a condition?

speak.title: Role-play: sauna or pub?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: You want to meet your friend at a sauna by the sea on Saturday morning. Explain why you like it. Try to answer your friend's worries about the cost and the cold.

b.text: You usually meet friends at the pub on Saturday night. You are not sure about a sauna. Ask about the price, the heat and whether you can talk. Decide if you will go.

phrases: I was hoping we could try something new.
I'm not sure it's really my thing.
It's quiet, so we can actually talk.
That's fair, but it's not cheap.
I'll give it a go, if you buy the first coffee.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: where did you decide to meet, and who gave way?
